base_candidate.portfolio: 60d inverse-vol risk parity A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% vol target [0.2,1.0], monthly

bootstrap.method: circular 20-trading-day block bootstrap of each variant daily return sequence

classification: preregistered defensive-overlay audit on the frozen R312/R314 candidate; no factor or risk-parity changes

execution.signal_timing: only prior month-end index or portfolio state; no same-day future information

gates.D1_data: >=1,300 full-path returns; >=95% of candidate trading dates present in HS300 index; all variants produce finite returns
gates.G1_execution: all four variants complete full, five recent fresh starts and 3x stress runs
gates.G7_recent: recent five-start mean >0 and at least 4/5 positive

known_limitations: HS300 MA200 and drawdown rules are risk overlays, not alpha signals; R56 previously found standalone index timing rules failed return/Sharpe gates.
All variants reuse the same historical path and are not independent confirmation.
R40 local snapshot and canonical data drift remain unresolved.
A passing overlay still requires paper-trading review before any production change.
question: R315 显示候选完整路径最近一年为正，但随机一年正收益率只有 71.1%、真实滚动一年只有 63.7%。在不加杠杆、不改选股和风险平价参数的前提下，加入简单的趋势/回撤软降仓，能否改善一年持有体验？
selection_rule: All variants are judged by G2-G9. Among passers, choose the highest bootstrap positive rate, tie-break by bootstrap median return. If no overlay beats base on the stated gates, keep the base candidate unchanged and record negative knowledge.

variants.dd10_half: At each month-end, if the candidate portfolio drawdown from its prior peak <= -10%, multiply total exposure by 0.50 for the next month; otherwise 1.0.
variants.ma200_half: At each month-end, if HS300 close <= 200-day MA, multiply total exposure by 0.50 for the next month; otherwise 1.0.
variants.ma200_quarter: At each month-end, if HS300 close <= 200-day MA, multiply total exposure by 0.25 for the next month; otherwise 1.0.
